d: Learn all about manners with the Guppies, as Molly helps aspiring princess Demanda get polite in time for the Glitter Games! Will they become true princesses together?

Gabby unboxes a charm bracelet that has a tiny bottle charm with a treasure map inside! Following the clues on the map, we travel through the dollhouse, solving riddles.

Dylan discovers his new substitute teacher is a former rap star, but after successfully reviving the former star's profile, Dylan finds that his own dream remains out of reach.
The family tries to make Dylan's first Christmas away from home special, but goes overboard trying to re-create his favourite traditions. Meanwhile, the kids don't have gifts for their parents.
